title: Capstone: ATM Simulator
description:
```
Welcome to C++ Bank
Enter PIN: ****
Wrong PIN. 2 attempts left.
Enter PIN: 1234
1) Balance  2) Deposit  3) Withdraw  4) Transfer to savings  5) History count  0) Exit
> 3
Amount: 500
Insufficient funds (balance $320.00)
```
requirements: Balances stored as integer **cents**, printed as dollars
Withdraw only multiples of $20, daily limit $500 (`static` local tracking today's total)
Code split into namespaces: `Bank::`, `Input::`, `Ui::` across multiple files
stretch: random "transaction fee" promotions, a fake interest tick each time a menu is shown.
